title: risk_assessment_results_response
description: One risk level and reason per area a merge request touches. Minimum risk levels and the overall risk level are applied by GitLab.

areas.description: Exactly one entry per area definition in the input, in the same order.

name.description: The area's name, exactly as the input spells it.

level.description: The risk level of the change in this area, per the area's criteria.

reason.description: At most twenty words naming the file or the change that decided the risk level.
